name: web-dark-meeting-notes-member-card-with-avatar-list-and-invite-action
title: Small dark 'Meeting Notes' card listing members with cartoon avatars and a dashed-circle Invite Member action
whatItIs: A black page with a small charcoal bordered card titled 'Meeting Notes' holding a two-column list: an 'Invite Member' entry with a dashed circle and plus icon, and three members with black-and-white cartoon face avatars, bold names and grey roles.
whatItMeans: Compact and friendly; illustrated avatars add character to a utility list.
techniques: Show an add action as a dashed circle.
Contain in a small bordered card.

vocabulary.definition: A dashed circle with a plus for adding.
A cartoon face drawn in outline.
An avatar with name and role.
A small container for a short list.
